verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents robust open-format export/import (Postman v2/2.1, HAR, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger, WSDL, cURL, Insomnia JSON/YAML) plus Git Sync that stores all project data directly in a user's own Git repo rather than locked in a proprietary cloud, and Apache-2.0 licensing gives full code portability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that a full account/collection can be exported losslessly, and community reports of a new account requirement (a 'rug pull' complaint) add friction to fully 'leaving' even though data formats remain open.
